quote.text: And I hold that no man has treated mankind worse than he who has studied philosophy as if it were some marketable trade, who lives in a different manner from that which he advises.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Emphasize integrity by aligning your advice to your actions, for children learn best when their parents live the principles they teach.
    • Avoid treating parenting as a set of marketable techniques; instead, cultivate a genuine sense of care and empathy that nurtures both character and wisdom.
  • Leadership
    • Practice what you preach: leadership demands that your daily actions reflect the virtues you promote, ensuring trust and respect among those you guide.
    • Resist the temptation to commodify philosophy; instead, embrace thoughtful reflection that inspires and elevates both your decisions and the culture of your team.
  • Product Management
    • Ensure that the strategies and values you advocate for in product management are consistently demonstrated in your decision-making and execution.
    • Focus on authenticity and ethical stewardship over marketable trends; build products and teams based on genuine understanding and commitment to your core principles.
